head_coach.name: Jamal Sellami
head_coach.play_style_summary: A highly disciplined, pragmatic approach utilizing an ultra-compact defensive shape that transforms into a 5-4-1 or 5-2-3 out of possession, heavily relying on rapid, direct, and devastating counter-attacks in transition.

key_players.name: Mousa Al-Tamari
key_players.performance_stats: Scored 7 goals and provided 11 assists in 36 games for French Ligue 1 side Stade Rennais FC, as well as scoring 7 goals during Jordan's World Cup qualification campaign.

key_players.name: Yazan Al-Arab
key_players.performance_stats: Experienced defensive leader playing for K League 1 club FC Seoul, serving as the central anchor of Jordan's stubborn backline.

key_players.name: Ali Olwan
key_players.performance_stats: Playing for Al-Sailiya SC, he was the top scorer in the Arab Cup and is expected to shoulder Jordan's primary goalscoring duties in the final tournament.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Ruled out of the World Cup squad due to a severe knee (anterior cruciate ligament) injury sustained at the Arab Cup.
Misses the tournament after suffering an anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) tear at the Arab Cup.
Officially excluded from the final tournament list due to a ruptured Achilles tendon sustained during individual training.
Sidelined on the eve of the tournament after suffering a torn ankle ligament in his left foot during national team training.
